# CONF-004: Every result carries resultType

| Severity | Applies to | Spec section |
|---|---|---|
| error | modern era, stdio, http | [2026-07-28/basic/index#result-responses](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/index#result-responses) |

Calls server/discover and, if tools are declared, tools/list. Every result MUST include a resultType string; values outside the core set (complete, input_required) are allowed only when the server advertises extensions.

From the command line: `mcpprobe checks explain CONF-004`. To leave it out of a run, add `"CONF-004"` to `[checks] disable` in [mcpprobe.toml](../configuration.md); to change how much it counts, use `severity_overrides`.
